subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my earlier email about winning back cart abandoners for {Brand}. With the 2026 Meta benchmarks now out, ecommerce CPA sits near a $30 median against a $38 all-industry average, and rising auction costs are squeezing that spread further across US retail. That is exactly where confirmed-purchase optimization and an audited holdout decide your real cost per recovered sale, the same recovery bar The Trade Desk and AdRoll are measured against. We report iROAS so the buyers you pay for are incremental. Worth a side-by-side with your current source mix?
angle: fresh angle: 2026 Meta ecommerce CPA benchmark (sourced ~$30 median vs $38 all-industry) + incrementality
register_notes: Stage 2 EN ecommerce retargeting: acknowledges 2nd follow-up + references prior; fresh angle = timely 2026 Meta benchmark release + real market CPA band ($30 ecommerce median vs $38 all-industry), web-verified with source_urls in enrichment_sources, never attributed to MobUpps; peers pack-sourced (The Trade Desk, AdRoll); iROAS/holdout reference with no MobUpps figure; 1 question mark; native US English; no sign-off; no X-not-Y; no em-dash.
